title: Consultancy to Scaling of the Africa CDC Continental Public Health Data Intelligence (HDI)
description: The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) invites qualified firms to submit proposals for the Scaling of the Africa CDC Continental Public Health Data Intelligence (HDI). The service request for Phase 2 of the HDI platform is focused on enhancing and expanding the existing platform delivered in Phase 1, while preserving and reusing the current system architecture and investments. Duration: 6 months Location: Africa CDC, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia Submission Deadline: July 7, 2026, Submission Email: procurement@africacdc.org Interested firms are requested to submit their proposals in accordance with the requirements and instructions set out in the Solicitation Document. Interested bidders must demonstrate experience in delivering large-scale data platforms, deploying solutions on both on-premises and cloud environments (especially Azure), and implementing federated public health and AI-driven systems. They should have strong open-source expertise, experience working with governments and sensitive health data, and the ability to enhance existing systems incrementally while preserving Phase 1 investments. The Request for Proposal (RFP) document can be obtained upon request from the procurement contact. Phase 2 aims to enhance and scale the existing HDI platform to enable secure public health data sharing, advanced analytics and AI-driven disease intelligence, reliable performance in low-connectivity environments, and strong governance, privacy, and compliance

title: Provision of catering services within the Africa CDC HQ compound.
description: Date of Publication : 10 June 2026 Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) is a continental autonomous health agency of the African Union established to support public health initiatives of Member States and strengthen the capacity of their public health institutions to detect, prevent, control and respond quickly and effectively to disease threats. Africa CDC supports African Union Member States in providing coordinated and integrated solutions to the inadequacies in their public health infrastructure, human resource capacity, disease surveillance, laboratory diagnostics, and preparedness and response to health emergencies and disasters. The Africa CDC Headquarters in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia currently comprises of more than 200 staff members operating in a multicultural and multi-linguistic environment and seeks to provide professional and authentic top-notch continental wide catering services in-order to satisfy its staff, invited delegates and guests to meet multicultural and multi-diverse needs. The Africa CDC wishes to engage professional service providers for Provision of Catering Service within the Africa CDC premises. title: Finland – Medical equipments, pharmaceuticals and personal care products – Diatermiatarvikkeet, DPS
description: Sansia Oy. Sansia Oy perustaa dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän, jonka kautta hankitaan tilaajakohtaisesti terveydenhuollossa käytettäviä moni- ja kertakäyttöisiä diatermiatarvikkeita. Hankintaan eivät sisälly diatermialaitteet. Tämä on hankintaa koskeva osallistumispyyntö. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän (DPS) kautta hankitaan diatermiatarvikkeita terveydenhuollon käyttöön. Hankittavia tuoteryhmiä ovat esimerkiksi: - diatermialaitetarvikkeet (ei diatermialaitteita) - savukaasuimutarvikkeet - monopolaari-, bipolaari- ja neutraalielektrodit - diatermiaelektrodien tarvikkeet - polttokynät ja polttoimutarvikkeet Hankinnan kohteena olevia tuotteita voidaan käyttää useissa eri käyttökohteissa ja kirurgian erikoisaloilla. Sansia Oy varaa mahdollisuuden hankkia dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kautta myös muita edellä mainittuun hankinnan kohteeseen liittyviä terveydenhuollon käyttöön soveltuvia diatermiatarvikkeita. Tätä dynaamista hankintajärjestelmää voivat käyttää kaikki Sansian omistaja-asiakkaat (ajantasainen listaus https://www.sansia.fi/yritys/omistajat.html). Hankintajärjestelmään voi hakeutua tarjoajaksi koko järjestelmän voimassaoloajan jättämällä osallistumishakemuksen. Ehdokas voi jättää osallistumishakemuksen järjestelmään, vaikka kaikki edellä esimerkinomaisesti mainitut tuoteryhmät eivät sisälly ehdokkaan tuotevalikoimaan.
